text:
maya: Heads-up — a customer reported the Token Cost dashboard is showing `$0` and `NaN` for some orgs since the nightly ingest. Affected orgs: org_652, org_981. Screenshot sent to the ticket. Can someone triage?

sam: On it. Can you paste the org ids and the time window they saw it? Also any recent deploys?

maya: Org ids above. They first noticed it around 2026-03-15 03:50 UTC. No frontend deploys in that window per status page.

jen: Quick repro notes: if ledger.row.price IS NULL, frontend rendering path treats it as 0 and some aggregations return NaN when dividing by zero in the sparkline calc. Minimal SQL to reproduce:```sql
-- returns rows with price NULL for those orgs
SELECT org_id, usage_day, SUM(tokens) as tokens, AVG(price) as price
FROM ledger_items
WHERE org_id IN ('org_652','org_981') AND usage_day BETWEEN '2026-03-14' AND '2026-03-15'
GROUP BY org_id, usage_day;
```

paul: Checking ingest logs now. I see repeated FX fetch failures around 03:58 UTC which is when price enrichment runs. Log snippet:```
[2026-03-15T03:58:12Z] ERROR ledger_ingest.fetch_fx: status=502 url=https://fx-service.internal/latest
[2026-03-15T03:58:12Z] WARN ledger_ingest.enrich_prices: price=null for 42 rows
```

sam: That matches. Two follow-ups: (1) UX quick-fix: change dashboard to display `N/A` for null price and avoid dividing by zero in sparkline; (2) backend fix: retry/backfill pipeline for the failed window and add circuit-breaker to use last-known FX instead of null. I'll open PR for the UX change and schedule backfill.

maya: Customer is on a paid plan and wants ETA. Can we give an estimated time for backfill?

paul: I'll kick off the backfill for org_652 first — should take ~20-30 mins for that org. Running: `python infra/tools/backfill_prices.py --org org_652 --start 2026-03-14 --end 2026-03-15`

deploy-bot: Created incident INC-2026-0453 and linked PR 4821 to the incident.

sam: I'll follow up once backfill completes and after the UX patch is rolled to staging. For now: advise support to tell customers we're actively remediating and will reconcile billed amounts post-backfill. :thumbsup:

maya: Thanks all — keep me posted and ping if ETA slips.
